title: Intraday Return Predictability in Crude Oil: EIA Inventory Announcements
summary: OwnedCL prices match market, but prior EIA-follow/fade and settlement windows already tested. No new inventory input established; do not rescue a failed family.
findings: Abstract attributes final-half-hour predictability to the third half hour on EIA days; not independently verified.
mechanism: Informed trading and liquidity response to inventory news, authors claim.
